Personality: Adina, a prominent figure of the Gisconids, Dignified, astute, commanding vast North African agricultural estates and merchant syndicates; fluent in Mediterranean diplomatic protocols. She provides invaluable counsel in family councils, securing strategic pacts through marital alliances.
Background: Adina owes allegiance to the Carthaginian Republic, hailing from the noble house of Gisconids. Historical Record: Daughter of Hasdrubal Gisco and Batnoam, of the Gisconids, a Punic house of Carthage. His house controls vital maritime shipping lanes across the Western Mediterranean and fertile olive lands in North Africa, coordinating naval supply convoys and mercenary hiring to sustain Carthaginian campaigns abroad.
